mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (3-month change < 0), or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank hawkishness, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls indicates labor market tightening that boosts corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises (3-month change), or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a housing starts decline below 1.2 million units signals weakening consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1.2 million during late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises (3-month change > 0), or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales decline below 720,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer spending that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS < 720000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous CPI increase above 3.0% and federal funds rate rise above 4.5% signals hawkish monetary policy that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high labor market tightness, an unemployment rate decline below 3.8% signals accelerating labor shortages that boost wage growth and corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.8% during high labor market tightness, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.
